channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Scuola Piccola Zattere: International Fellowship and Residency 2027 (Venice)
    https://scuolapiccolazattere.com/en/events/internationalfellowship-2-3
    Scuola Piccola Zattere · deadline 04 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 fellowship grant plus a EUR 2,000 research budget, accommodation in Venice, an individual study space within a shared studio, and round-trip travel to Venice. Collectives and duos share a single grant and one accommodation. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Stiftung Künstler*dorf Schöppingen: Residency Fellowship 2027 Open Call
    https://stiftung-kuenstlerdorf.de/en/application_process
    Stiftung Künstler*dorf Schöppingen · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,500 per month, minus roughly EUR 100-200 for rent and operating expenses. For collectives, EUR 1,000 per person up to a maximum of EUR 3,000 per month, minus rent and operating costs. Travel, insurance and material costs are covered only in exceptional cases, on request.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Jan van Eyck Academie: Material Research Fellowships 2027 (Future Materials)
    https://www.janvaneyck.nl/calendar/2-material-research-fellowships-2027/
    Jan van Eyck Academie (Future Materials / Future Threads programme, co-funded by the EU Just Transition Fund) · deadline Closed 24 Jun 2026 · Monthly stipend of EUR 1,750 (80% exempt from income tax) plus an annual working budget of EUR 2,250, a private studio apartment, and access to the Jan van Eyck Labs and external partners. Application fee EUR 50 excl. VAT (waived for applicants from DAC-list lower-income countries and territories).
